2608.00679.title: HetGPS: Scalable Graph Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Physics-Anchored Adaptive Safety for EV Charging
2608.00679.paper_summary: Safety interventions for large populations of network-coupled agents must protect shared constraints without unnecessarily overriding task-oriented policy decisions. We present HetGPS, a hybrid graph-control framework synergizing learned graph risk with physics-anchored correction by separating intervention magnitude from corrective direction. An action-conditioned graph residual model schedules state-dependent intervention authority, while a physics model determines its direction. For electric vehicle (EV) charging, we couple this filter with a parameter-shared heterogeneous graph soft actor-critic policy, enabling topology-aware coordination with a learned model size independent of fleet size. Across five nested distribution networks with 200--3,218 EVs and 100 evaluation days, Adaptive Authority reduces bus--step voltage violations from 3.93--7.74\% without filtering to 0.52--3.44\%, while maintaining 99.06--100\% departure success. Relative to the same physics-directed projection with fixed authority, it improves mean reward on all five networks and lowers the mean safety score on four. The deployed policy-and-risk model contains 383,702 learned parameters at every scale; at 3,218 EVs, a matched centralized SAC actor is about $170\times$ larger. A policy trained on the eight-transformer system transfers zero-shot to the 16- and 32-transformer systems, attaining 0.57--0.75\% violation rates and at least 99.99\% departure success. These results show that learned graph risk can allocate intervention authority at scale while feeder physics anchors corrective action.
2608.00679.paper_summary_zh: 安全干預措施針對大型網絡耦合代理必須保護共享約束，而不必不必要地覆蓋以任務為導向的政策決策。<lb/>我們提出了HetGPS，一個混合圖控制框架，通過將干預幅度與修正方向分開，協同學習的圖風險與基於物理的修正。<lb/>一個基於行動條件的圖殘差模型安排狀態依賴的干預權限，而一個物理模型則決定其方向。<lb/>對於電動車（EV）充電，我們將此過濾器與一個參數共享的異質圖軟演員-評論家政策結合，實現了與拓撲感知協調的學習模型，其大小與車隊大小無關。<lb/>在五個嵌套的配電網絡中，擁有200到3,218輛EV和100個評估日，適應性權限將巴士步驟電壓違規從未過濾的3.93到7.74\%減少到0.52到3.44\%，同時保持99.06到100\%的出發成功率。<lb/>相對於同樣的物理導向投影與固定權限，它在所有五個網絡上提高了平均獎勵，並在四個網絡上降低了平均安全分數。<lb/>部署的政策和風險模型在每個規模上包含383,702個學習參數；在3,218輛EV的情況下，匹配的集中式SAC演員約為$170\times$更大。<lb/>在八Transformer系統上訓練的政策在16和32Transformer系統上實現零次轉移，達到0.57到0.75\%的違規率和至少99.99\%的出發成功率。<lb/>這些結果顯示，學習的圖風險可以在規模上分配干預權限，而配電物理則為修正行動提供基礎。
